records.title_verbatim: HIGHER NITEC IN HAIRDRESSING & SALON MANAGEMENT (2 YEARS)
records.entry_as_published: GCE 'O' level grades 1-7 in English Language and two other subjects; applicants must have sat for Mathematics; or eligible Nitec GPA pathway.

modules.outcome_verbatim: On completion of this module, students should be able to perform shampooing at basin, seated shampoo, massage scalp, neck and shoulder, and towel dry hair.
On completion of this module, students should be able to colour virgin hair.
On completion of this module, students should be able to perform upstyles.
On completion of this module, students should be able to blow-dry various lengths of hair.
On completion of this module, students should be able to prepare and execute e-marketing plans on social media platforms.
On completion of this module, students should be able to manage customer’s needs, wants, expectations and feedback, promote products and services, and provide service recovery to customers.
On completion of this module, students should be able to perform grey hair coverage and colour regrowth hair.
On completion of this module, students should be able to perform hair perming and digital perm.
On completion of this module, students should be able to perform blunt haircuts.
On completion of this module, students should be able to perform layered haircuts.
On completion of this module, students should be able to perform highlighting or lowlighting of hair.
On completion of this module, students should be able to perform bleaching and toning of hair.
On completion of this module, students should be able to analyse and treat hair and scalp problems, and recommend follow-up actions.
On completion of this module, students should be able to apply the skills and knowledge acquired to take on a range of job scope at the company.
On completion of this module, students should be able to perform graduated haircuts.
On completion of this module, students should be able to provide combination haircuts.
On completion of this module, students should be able to create formal and informal updos for different occasions.
On completion of this module, students should be able to chemically straighten natural curly or wavy hair.
